title: IneligibleCreditSupport
description: A class to specify the parties to which the provisions of the Credit Support Annex for Variation Margin will apply to.

totalIneligibilityDate.description: Total Ineligibility Date has the meaning specified in Paragraph 11(g), unless otherwise specified here.

transferIneligibilityDate.description: Transfer Ineligibility Date has the meaning specified in Paragraph 11(g), unless otherwise specified here.

specifiedParty.description: The parties to which the provisions of the CSA will apply to, as the Secured Party.
